topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session, connects it to histopathology practicals, and outlines the learning outcomes.

topics.label: Tumour virology and cellular transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the study of tumour viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and establish the laboratory assays used to test transforming activity.

topics.label: Functional classification and genetic mechanisms of cancer genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer mutations in oncogenes and tumour suppressor genes alter cell cycle checkpoints and cellular phenotypes across different allele dosages and mutation types.

topics.label: Mechanisms and consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how failures in DNA repair pathways, replication fidelity, and mitotic chromosome segregation produce sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multi-step tumour progression and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address how the sequential acquisition or germline inheritance of mutations drives tumour evolution and malignancy.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session, offers to take questions, and recommends further reading.
